explanation: Cameroon beat the holders, Argentina, in the opening match, and Roger Milla, aged 38, scored four goals. Morocco became the first African semi-finalists in 2022.

claims.text: Cameroon was the first African team to reach a men's World Cup quarter-final, in 1990.
Nigeria, Senegal and Ghana had not reached a men's World Cup quarter-final by 1990; Senegal first did so in 2002 and Ghana in 2010.
At the 1990 World Cup Cameroon beat the holders, Argentina, 1-0 in the opening match.
Roger Milla was 38 at the 1990 World Cup and scored four goals there.
Morocco became the first African team to reach a men's World Cup semi-final, in 2022.
